instruction.text: It’s always a good idea to plan your journey before you leave. Complete the questions you should ask yourself.

atoms.sound: Where do you want to go?
what is the safest way to get there?

instruction.text: Select the top that helps you be seen more easily when walking along the road in daylight.

feedback.end: It’s a good idea to wear bright clothes that help you to be seen more easily by cars.

instruction.text: Select the top that helps you be seen more easily when walking along the road at night.

feedback.end: It’s especially important to wear something bright and reflective at night.

instruction.text: Select the safest place to walk along the road.

feedback.end: Correct! You should always walk on the pavement and keep a safe distance from the kerb.

atoms.b: You should always use a ((++pavement cycle_lane)) or footway if there is one.
If you ((++have want)) to walk in the road, you should walk on the right-hand side. This means you can see ((++traffic birds)) coming your way.
When you’re with someone ((++younger taller)) than you, you should always ((++hold shake)) their hand.

instruction.text: Which situation do you think is safer? Select the correct image.

feedback.end: If you’re walking along a busy road with someone else, you should walk one in front of the other in a line.
